scope: English Repos base game, supplied scope: 2021 publication, sc-en01, ©2020; complete standard game; optional Add a Challenge excluded

checked_claims.detail: Cooperative word association; combine individual board scores and pursue team high score.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.1 introduction; p.6 END OF THE GAME

checked_claims.detail: 220 Keyword cards, 6 boards, 6 markers, Record of Legends and rulebook.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.1 CONTENTS

checked_claims.detail: Each player receives a board and marker; shuffle into accessible face-down deck; draw four cards and randomly place in recessed spaces, hidden from others.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.1 SETUP steps 1–3

checked_claims.detail: Choosing Clues is individual, simultaneous and secret; Resolution is collective and starts after everyone completes their preparation.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.2 GAMEPLAY and CHOOSING CLUES; p.4 opening paragraphs

checked_claims.detail: Eight outside-edge Keywords form four Pairs; two adjacent Keywords below each corresponding Clue Zone form that Pair.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.2 CHOOSING CLUES text and labeled diagram; inspected pdf-page-2.png

checked_claims.detail: Exactly four Clues, each connecting both Keywords in its Pair and written in the corresponding zone.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.2 final paragraphs; p.4 opening sentence

checked_claims.detail: Single word, compound words allowed; common noun, proper noun, acronym, number and onomatopoeia are allowed, including the examples reproduced.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.2 final paragraphs

checked_claims.detail: Neither Pair Keyword or its translation; same-family words and invented words prohibited; all three examples reproduced accurately.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.3 Invalid Clues

checked_claims.detail: Advice to write first word that comes to mind is reproduced without introducing an exemption from clue restrictions.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.3 ADVICE, read with p.2 clue rules and p.3 Invalid Clues

checked_claims.detail: Remove four original cards; draw one unseen new card; shuffle all five; put face-down pile atop board in front of owner.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.4 opening paragraph

checked_claims.detail: Choose first Spectator at start of Resolution; owner cannot communicate in any way; every player serves exactly once.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.4 2. RESOLUTION first paragraph

checked_claims.detail: Owner places board and five cards face up centrally; others use Clues to reconstruct original Pairs and correct card placements, with four cards on board and extra off board.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.4 2. RESOLUTION second paragraph; p.5 verification diagram

checked_claims.detail: Correct card orientation matters: p.5 diagram marks the lower-left card incorrect despite being the original card in its original recess, with the other three cards marked correct. Summary accurately makes this consequence explicit.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.2 geometry diagram; p.5 verification diagram, inspected pdf-page-5.png

checked_claims.detail: Guessers may discuss and physically try arrangements; player to Spectator’s left resolves disagreements; verification follows agreement.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.4 disagreement paragraph, ADVICE and final sentence

checked_claims.detail: All Pairs correct gives four card points plus two bonus points, total six; board then resolves without second attempt.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.5 First attempt / Perfect; board-completion paragraph

checked_claims.detail: Any erroneous Pair triggers silent removal of incorrect cards to table middle; team has a second and final attempt. Correct cards remain on board during that feedback.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.5 First attempt / Error and verification diagram

checked_claims.detail: After renewed agreement remove incorrect cards to table middle; one point per correct card, zero through four, with no first-attempt bonus and no third attempt.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.5 Second attempt; preceding second-and-final-attempt sentence

checked_claims.detail: Turn board over, write board score centrally, discard all five used cards; next Spectator is owner’s left neighbor.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.5 final two paragraphs

checked_claims.detail: End after everyone has served once; add board scores, write team score in Record of Legends and compare against high score.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.6 END OF THE GAME

checked_claims.detail: Optional Add a Challenge is explicitly excluded; no player-count or duration claim is invented; designer and copyright agree with source.
checked_claims.source_references: PDF p.1 author credit and component/setup text; p.6 ADD A CHALLENGE and CREDITS; complete six-page source contains no explicit player-count or duration statement

checked_claims.detail: All consequential standard-game instructions on all six source pages are represented; no essential standard-game rule gap identified.
checked_claims.source_references: Complete PDF pp.1–6 and complete extracted text

method: Read exact full summary snapshot and complete extracted text. Independently extracted and read every page of the authoritative six-page PDF using pypdf. Visually inspected allowed PDF renders for pages 2, 4 and 5, especially Pair geometry and orientation feedback. No online sources used.
independence_statement: Fresh final source audit. I did not author repairs and did not read questions, answer keys, reader outputs, grades, previous summaries or audits, coverage reports, parent history, or other task files. The verification banner was not accepted as evidence. Findings and verdict were determined from the exact snapshot and the complete supplied authoritative source; the snapshot was not edited.
